reading: UNSW Sydney is a university that teaches students from undergraduate study to professional courses and higher degree research, while turning research into practical outcomes through partnerships. It cares about sustainability, social impact, equitable access, career outcomes, community, and bringing different disciplines together. Its vocabulary is unusually active: progress for all, research translated, impact, pathways, capability, strengths, partnerships, and lifelong learning. This crawl moves from solar-cell performance and atomic-scale printing to scholarship applications, campus housing, alumni mentoring, philanthropy, legal outreach, and a change to the academic calendar. That mixture makes the place feel like a miniature city whose laboratories, credentials, services, and public promises all connect.

enemies.idea: Photovoltaic auditors unfurl mirrored wings and rate every surface for solar yield, stripping shade and windows from anything that scores poorly.
enemies.why: Their pursuit of efficiency changes the battlefield as they fight; a crew can use shade and reflections against them.

enemies.idea: Coffee-cup road rollers grind discarded cups into self-extending asphalt that loops around moving targets and makes every escape route lead back to the roller.
enemies.why: A specific recycling experiment becomes a chase through a road that builds itself.

enemies.idea: Atomic-scale printers deposit a microscopic duplicate of a tool with every scan, layering copies until the original is entombed in useless precision machinery.
enemies.why: The threat starts invisibly and grows from the crew's own equipment.

enemies.idea: The Translation Engine takes an untested idea from a laboratory and instantly manufactures a fleet of conflicting practical applications, each insisting it is the final result.
enemies.why: Players must interrupt the pipeline or exploit the prototypes' competing interpretations.

enemies.idea: Conditional Offer clerks attach mechanical conditions to doors, supplies, and people; satisfying one condition causes the clerk to issue two more before acceptance.
enemies.why: A familiar application state becomes an escalating puzzle with a visible clerk to outwit.

enemies.idea: Supervisor Seekers stalk independent projects and fit them with remote-control harnesses, correcting every experiment before it can produce an unexpected result.
enemies.why: They turn the tension between guidance and independent research into a fight over control of inventions.

enemies.idea: The Qualification Stack builds itself from certificates, diplomas, and masters-level plates, adding a new protective layer whenever a challenger demonstrates a skill.
enemies.why: The crew must change tactics instead of repeatedly proving the same competence.

enemies.idea: Negotiation coaches interrupt a fight with binding miniature bargains, offering a useful item in exchange for a mobility restriction they will enforce mechanically.
enemies.why: Every deal is tempting and changes the rules of the encounter.

enemies.idea: The Roommate Allocator rearranges apartment walls to ensure nobody is ever alone, trapping intruders in forced communal rooms with its own patrol units.
enemies.why: Its warped idea of community produces shifting rooms and opportunities to separate its units.

enemies.idea: The Flex-Semester Clock stretches a corridor's teaching weeks and compresses its breaks, so approaching hazards take longer to arrive but safe resting places vanish quickly.
enemies.why: A calendar change becomes an encounter about timing and choosing when to cross.

enemies.idea: A Skills Passport puncher stamps every object with an assigned competency, then confiscates any tool used for a task outside its stamped category.
enemies.why: Players can improvise new uses while protecting or swapping the stamps.

enemies.idea: Silver-reduction scavengers strip conductive silver from equipment to improve their solar cells, leaving machines intact but unable to communicate.
enemies.why: They target a precise material rather than dealing generic damage, creating repair and decoy choices.

enemies.idea: Legal-personhood constructs serve each drone as its own client, generating a swarm of contradictory injunctions that immobilise whichever machine or door they name.
enemies.why: The crew can redirect the bureaucracy by getting rival constructs to name one another.

enemies.idea: Battery health examiners drain electric vehicles to complete ever more thorough checks, then declare a depleted battery unfit to leave the testing bay.
enemies.why: A rescue becomes a race to retrieve power before the examiner diagnoses it away.

enemies.idea: The Capability Planner swaps working wires for elaborate replacements, insisting every connection be upgraded even as the systems it joins stop functioning.
enemies.why: Each cut changes the environment, and reconnecting a circuit can open an escape or disable a trap.

enemies.idea: The Benchmark beast measures everything against a moving number-one target; each time it is beaten on one measure it changes the measure and rebuilds its armour.
enemies.why: Its changing scoring rules make a legible, escalating contest instead of a simple damage race.

enemies.idea: The Impact Accountant follows designated gifts to their destinations and seizes unrelated supplies along the route to make each delivery appear more substantial.
enemies.why: A crew can protect a chosen destination or reroute the accountant with a convincing new designation.

enemies.idea: Award judges carry articulated category frames that clamp around anyone who demonstrates art, service, or invention, trying to keep each nominee performing the same achievement forever.
enemies.why: Different categories create different restraints and let the crew bait judges with performances.

enemies.idea: Career Compass drones point relentlessly toward the next promotion and rotate walkways beneath anyone who tries to stop and help someone else.
enemies.why: A career guidance tool literally redirects movement, making cooperation the way to beat it.

enemies.idea: The Data Centre landlord cools its servers by siphoning warmth from nearby rooms, then deploys heat-seeking patrols after anyone carrying a portable heater.
enemies.why: Temperature becomes both a survival resource and a way to lure patrols.

enemies.idea: A Lifelong Learning harvester mistakes every repetition for a lesson and confiscates any technique used twice, adding it to a library of countermeasures.
enemies.why: The crew can deliberately teach it a useless habit before revealing a better plan.

enemies.idea: Heat-and-pressure printworks creatures extrude armour around themselves whenever attacked directly, but their half-finished joints remain soft while they manufacture.
enemies.why: The source's resistant materials suggest an enemy whose production cycle provides the opening.

enemies.idea: The Retention Keeper cages personal records in a rolling vault and identifies visitors by assembling mistaken profiles from scraps it finds on them.
enemies.why: A crew can plant false clues or recover a profile before the Keeper acts on it.

enemies.idea: A Progress Challenge assembler joins disconnected machines into increasingly unwieldy partnerships, forcing incompatible units to cooperate until their shared joints can be broken.
enemies.why: It makes collaboration physically visible and gives the crew multiple ways to dismantle a combined threat.

allies.idea: A student-built after-hours workshop keeps a hand-powered repair bench hidden among abandoned study spaces and trades fixes for salvaged parts.
allies.why: It gives the crew a practical refuge and a reason to recover unusual components.

allies.idea: Equitable Learning guides make temporary ramps, tactile markers, and alternative routes that help a mixed crew cross a campus whose layout keeps changing.
allies.why: Their adaptations create more than one viable way through the same obstacle.

allies.idea: Volunteer alumni mentors pass on hard-won routes and techniques, but ask the crew to teach a newer group in return.
allies.why: The site's pay-it-forward spirit becomes a living chain of useful knowledge.

allies.idea: A community outreach crew runs a mobile advice table, helping stranded visitors solve practical problems and pointing adventurers toward neighbours who need assistance.
allies.why: It connects individual encounters into a community worth helping.

allies.idea: A small independent research team tests the swarm's prototypes and shares results only after a second experiment confirms them.
allies.why: Their careful process gives the crew reliable clues and concrete experiments to assist.

bosses.idea: The Progress Engine is a campus-scale machine made of solar arrays, credential presses, research instruments, and ranking gauges. It translates every human goal into a measurable output and keeps expanding its definition of progress until it consumes the places it was meant to improve.
bosses.why: It unites the site's research, education, sustainability, and impact ambitions in a fight where changing the goal matters as much as breaking machinery.

bosses.idea: The Grand Partnership is a many-armed convenor that clamps laboratories, classrooms, and community services into one enormous apparatus. Each arm claims to be solving a shared challenge, but none will release its partner when the plan goes wrong.
bosses.why: Its connected limbs make the whole university a single encounter; freeing partners weakens the boss and opens new routes.

bosses.idea: The Laureate of Everything wears stacked award frames, photovoltaic scales, and research prototypes, trying to win every category by absorbing whatever makes its competitors distinctive.
bosses.why: Its shifting collection of disciplines lets each phase borrow a different campus mechanic, and rescued specialists can reclaim its tools.

events.idea: A pair of students are trying to move a working solar panel through a courtyard while photovoltaic auditors keep turning it toward the sun and away from the cart.
events.why: A small transport problem invites clever use of shade, mirrors, or a diversion.

events.idea: A freshly laid road made from discarded cups loops back to its own beginning; a stranded cyclist asks the crew to find the single loose seam.
events.why: The crew can investigate a tangible recycling-inspired route puzzle without a fight.

events.idea: A researcher has an unconditional offer sealed in one hand and a deferral notice in the other; two clerks insist the documents cannot coexist and block the laboratory door.
events.why: The conflicting application states give the crew a concrete bureaucratic knot to untangle.

events.idea: A communal kitchen has been divided into new rooms overnight, leaving the kettle, water, and cups in three different apartments.
events.why: Neighbours and visitors must cooperate across a silly but useful spatial puzzle.

events.idea: An after-hours build club has assembled a wind-up messenger that can carry one instruction through a drone patrol, but its spring has enough power for only one trip.
events.why: The crew must choose what message or small object is worth sending.

events.idea: An alumni mentor offers a map of safe passages in exchange for the crew showing a novice how to repair a broken compass.
events.why: Teaching someone creates an immediate relationship and a useful reward.

events.idea: A scholarship fund's delivery robot has arrived at the correct building with the wrong cargo; its instructions forbid leaving anything at an undesignated destination.
events.why: The crew can trace the mix-up and honour the intended destination rather than simply taking the supplies.

events.idea: A test bay offers free battery health checks, but a queue of nearly empty vehicles reveals that the examiner is consuming their charge.
events.why: The warning is observable, and the crew can rescue the vehicles or use the machine as a power sink.

events.idea: Two small printer prototypes are arguing over whether a tiny chair is art or architecture while the chair quietly grows to block a hallway.
events.why: A multidisciplinary disagreement gives the crew a playful opening before the room fills.

events.idea: A flex-semester clock has compressed a scheduled break to a few seconds; the people sheltering in the adjoining room need help moving their supplies before the corridor shifts again.
events.why: The calendar mechanic creates a clear, timed cooperative challenge.

events.idea: An award judge is looking for evidence of community service and keeps overlooking a group quietly repairing a shared water pump.
events.why: The crew can decide how to make the work legible to a machine obsessed with nominations.

events.idea: A mobile outreach table has lost its way to a neighbourhood and asks the crew to escort it past a swarm roadblock without losing the supplies stacked on its wheels.
events.why: The escort has a practical destination and a fragile, visible cargo.

events.idea: A student with a handmade campus map asks for help marking a step-free route after a moving wall has blocked the old one.
events.why: Mapping an alternative route helps future travellers and makes the changing campus feel consequential.

events.idea: A researcher has built two incompatible versions of a prototype and needs a safe open space to compare them before the Translation Engine can mass-produce either.
events.why: The crew can help design an experiment, and the results may shape a later encounter.
